title: Concept: vcpkg registry without a baseline
description: vcpkg-configuration.json declares a registry entry that records no baseline commit, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Port versions come from the registry's current head, so a port can change without any change to the project.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through vcpkg-configuration.json (vcpkg).
risk: Port versions come from the registry's current head, so a port can change without any change to the project.
